description: This file provides a data service module for a mechanic portal application, handling local storage, external API interactions with Supabase, user authentication, request management, and profile updates.

methods.name: isSupabaseConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the necessary environment variables for Supabase are set.

methods.name: getMechanicStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the mechanic application status, either from Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: registerMechanic
methods.description: Handles mechanic registration, including creating a user in Supabase or local mock data, and updating profiles.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates a new service request, either via Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user via Supabase or local mock data, and retrieves user role and status.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user from Supabase or local mock session.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Fetches the current authenticated user, including role and approval status.

methods.name: listUnassignedRequests
methods.description: Lists all requests that are unassigned, via Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: listMyAssignments
methods.description: Lists requests assigned to a mechanic, via Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: getRequestById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific request by ID, via Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: acceptRequest
methods.description: Assigns a request to a mechanic and updates its status, via Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: updateRequestStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a request, with optional notes, via Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates user profile information, via Supabase or local mock data.
